nodes.statement: The Cleveland heart disease dataset has a well-known structure: 14 columns (303 rows), with column 14 being the diagnosis (0 = no disease, 1–4 = severity). Column 2 (thalach = maximum heart rate achieved) is a continuous physiological measure plausibly inversely related to disease severity. This yields a checkable mean-difference prediction.

The 13-feature patient space can be reduced via PCA; if disease lies on a low-dimensional manifold, the cumulative variance explained by the first k components should rise sharply (non-linear growth) rather than linearly — predicting a spectral gap at k=2 or 3.

Framing diagnosis as logistic regression, the cross-validated accuracy should increase monotonically but sub-linearly with feature count, saturating once redundant features (restecg, fbs) are added — predicting a concave accuracy-vs-p curve with an elbow at p≈6.

在 Cleveland 心脏病数据中，target≥1（确诊冠心病，n≈160–170）患者的最大心率 thalach（第 14 列之前的连续列）均值显著低于 target=0（无病，n≈130–140）组，且 Welch 检验的均值差 95% 置信区间（用 t 分布临界值）完全位于 0 以下；同时 thalach 与 target 的 point-biserial 相关系数 r_pb 的绝对值 ≥ 0.30（中等效应量），方向为负。
